Then she carried the page upstairs, pinned it above the lamp, and polished the great lens until it shone brighter than it had in years.", "w02": "凌晨四点，城市还没有醒来。路灯在薄雾里投下昏黄的光圈，空荡的街道像一条沉睡的河。远处，环卫工人的扫帚划过地面，发出沙沙的声响。早点铺的卷帘门悄悄升起，蒸笼里冒出第一缕白气。高楼的窗户大多暗着，只有零星几盏亮着，那是熬夜的人，或是早起的人。一辆夜班公交缓缓驶过，车厢里只有几位疲惫的乘客。风带着露水的凉意，天边还看不到一丝光亮，却已经有鸟儿试探着叫了一声。", "w03": "- Recursion is when a job is solved by doing a smaller copy of the same job, like opening a Russian nesting doll that has a smaller doll inside.\n- Each copy keeps passing the job down to a smaller one until it reaches the tiniest copy, which is so easy it can be solved right away.\n- Then the answers travel back up, one copy at a time, until the biggest job is finished."}
